name: Blikanasaurus
sum: Blikanasaurus is a sauropodomorph from the Late Triassic of South Africa, known from a hindfoot and a metatarsal.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
material: A second specimen, a right metatarsal, was found in the early 2000s at Damplaats.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Galton and Van Heerden 1985
